messages.content:
[1] קפדי (Aramaic) = "displeased" — in: דניהדרו להו בתיובתא והוו [קפדי] רבנן כי נח נפשיה
  rejected: קְפַד
  1. פַּדָּא — = פדעא; פְּדַע; cmp. פָּדוֹעָא); פ׳ דמרא blade of the hoe (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Ascia); [comment. the club, handle of the hoe; blow, wound
  2. פדי — b. h.) [to cut loose,] to liberate, redeem; Nif. to be redeemed
  3. פְּדֵי — ch., v. פְּדַע I
  4. פָּדַע — b. h.) = פָּדָה, to redeem
  5. פְּדַע I — cmp. פדד, s. v. פַּדָּן) to split; to wound
  6. פְּדַע II — preced.) blow, wound
  7. קָפַד — b. h.) to contract, convolve, v. קוּפָּד; Hif. cmp. קָצַף); Hif. to be angry, lose temper; Hif. to provoke, insult; Hif. to be strict, particular; to care for, mind

[2] תנאי (Aramaic) = "a dispute of tannaim" — in: לימא פחת נבילה [תנאי] היא דתניא אם טרף
  rejected: תְּנַאי
  1. תְּנָאָה — = next w., stipulation, agreement, condition
  2. תַּנַּאי — = תַּנָּא
  3. תְּנֵי — to repeat, do a second time; to tell, relate; to teach; Pa. to change; Pa. to tell, relate; to teach; Af. to stipulate, agree, make a condition; Af. to relate, teach; Ithpe. to be repeated; Ithpe. to be told, reported
  4. תְּנָא — v. תְּנֵי
  5. תני — v. שָׁנָה) [to repeat,] to tell; Pi. same; Hif. to stipulate, agree, make a condition
  6. תְּנֵי II — cmp. שנן) to be pointed, sharp; Pa. to sharpen, to speak sharp words; Ithpe. to be sharpened
  7. תַּנָּא — preced.) teacher, esp. Tanna, an authority quoted in Mishnah and Boraitha, contrad. to אֲמוֹרָא

[3] אחתיה (Aramaic) = "the sister of" — in: ריש בריוני דירושלים בר [אחתיה] דרבן יוחנן בן זכאי
  rejected: אֶחָד
  1. אַחַת — v. אֶחָד
  2. אָחַד — sec. r. of חוּד, v. חוּד I) to join, close. Part. pass. אָחוּד, pl. אֲחוּדִים; closed up, mysterious; joined, united
  3. אֲחַד — Pa. אָחֵיד, אַחֵד ch. (v. foreg.); corresp. to h. סגר a. תפש; cmp. h. אחז) to close (the door), to lock up; to seize, capture; to devote, v. אֲחִיד; Af. to seize; Ithpe. to be seized; Ithpe. to be locked up, joined
  4. אֲחָת — (no English given)

[4] יונתן (Aramaic) = "Yonatan" — in: בר נחמני אמר רבי [יונתן] מותר להסתכל בפני כלה
  rejected: יוֹנָתָן


[5] שבוע (Aramaic) = "Savua" — in: בן גוריון ובן כלבא [שבוע] ובן ציצית הכסת נקדימון
  rejected: שָׁבוּעַ
  1. שֶׁבַע — b. h.) seven
  2. שְׁבַע — (no English given)
  3. שָׁבַע — Nif. נִשְׁבַּע (b. h.) to be sworn, to swear; Hif. to adjure; to impose, administer an oath
  4. שְׁבַע II — Ithpa. אִשְׁתַּבַּע, Ithpe. אִשְׁתְּבַע, אִישְּׁבַע as preced. Nif; Af. as preced. Hif
  5. שָׂבֵעַ I — next w.) sated, filled, satisfied
  6. שָׂבֵעַ II — to be filled, to have plenty, be satisfied; Hif. to satisfy; Pi. same.—Part. pass. מְשׂוּבָּע; Hithpa. to be satiated, sick
  7. שְׂבַע — to be satisfied, saturated; Pa. Af. אַשְׂבַּע, אַסְ׳ to satisfy; *. cmp. צָבָה) to be swollen
  8. שָׂבָע — v. שׂוֹבַע, שׂוֹבְעָא, a. סִבְעָא
  9. שׂוֹבַע — plenty, satiation
  10. שׂוֹבַע ² — (no English given)
  11. שׁוֹבַע — v. שְׁבַע I

[6] רבן (Aramaic) = "their teacher" — in: למדקריה אמר להו יאמרו [רבן] דקרו בעו למדחפיה אמר
  rejected: רַבָּן
  1. רבן — (no English given)
  2. רָכַן I — cmp. preced. wds.) to be tender, soft; Hif. to make tender; to prevent onion plants from forming hard bulbs
  3. רָכַן II — preced.) to bend; Hif. to bend (act. a. neut. verb); to yield; Hif. to sink, be faint
  4. רְכַן ² — to incline, sink, fall; to bend, turn; Af. to bend, incline; Af. to cause to sink; Ithpe. to incline, let one’s self down; to fall; Ithpe. to be dragged
  5. רַבָּן ² — chief; teacher

[7] כדריש (Aramaic) = "like (the view of) Reish" — in: בהך לא מסתייעא מילתא [כדריש] לקיש דאמר ריש לקיש
  rejected: רֵישׁ II
  1. דָּרֵישׁ — lecturer, v. דְּרַשׁ
  2. דָּרַשׁ — b. h.); to examine, question. Denom. דְּרִישָׁה; to expound, interpret; in gen.) to teach, lecture; Nif. to be interpreted, expounded. Sifra, introd. rules שהתורה נִדְרֶשֶׁת בהן by which the Law is interpreted; Hithpa. same
  3. דְּרַשׁ — Ithpe. to be interpreted
  4. רִישׁ — v. רָשׁ) poverty, misery
  5. רֵישׁ III — = b. h. רֹאשׁ (cmp. רִיס I) [drop,] poison

[8] ריש (Aramaic) = "Reish" — in: [ריש] לקיש אמר מהכא כפלח
  rejected: רֵישׁ II
  1. רִישׁ — v. רָשׁ) poverty, misery
  2. רֵישׁ III — = b. h. רֹאשׁ (cmp. רִיס I) [drop,] poison

[9] והוא (Aramaic) = "and this (applies)" — in: בר מרתא משמיה דרב [והוא] דכתיב רוביה דספרא שפיר
  rejected: הוּא ²
  1. הוּא — b. h.) he, it; she; it is &c
  2. הֲוָא — v. הוי
  3. הֲוֵי — fut. יֶהֱוֵי, יְהֵא, יְהֵי ch; same; to dwell upon, discuss, v. infra; Pa. הַוֵּא; Pa. to produce; Pa. also Peel) with ב or על to dwell upon, to discuss, argue, oppose, cmp. קים
  4. הוֹי — b. h.) woe!, ah!
  5. הוי — b. h.) to exist; to be, become; to occur, come to pass.—With part. ה׳ מביט he looked; ה׳ אומר he said, freq. u; frequent, usual; existing, enduring; Pi. v. הְוָיָה; Pi. to change one’s legal status, to dispose of; Pi. to produce, make
  6. הָא I — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  7. הָא II — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  8. הֵא II — He-He
  9. הִא III — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  10. הָהּ — interj.) ah, alas!
  11. הֵה — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate

[10] דהי (Aramaic) = "of the letter heh" — in: איפסיקא ליה כרעא [דהי] דהעם בניקבא אתא לקמיה
  rejected: הֵי II
  1. הֵי I — pr. n. m., v. הֵא II
  2. הָא I — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  3. הָא II — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  4. הֵא II — He-He
  5. הִא III — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  6. הִי I — she, v. הוּ
  7. הוּ — v. הוּא ch
  8. הִי II — m. (b. h

[11] דיקולי (Aramaic) = "Dikkulei" — in: דהוא חמוה דרמי בר [דיקולי] איפסיקא ליה כרעא דויו
  rejected: דִּיקוּלָא
  1. קוּלָּא — lenient rule, easier practice

[12] משרו (Aramaic) = "they sing" — in: רב דימי אמר הכי [משרו] קמי כלתא במערבא לא
  rejected: שרי ²
  1. שֵׁירוּתָא ² — שְׁרֵי) beginning
  2. שֵׁירוּי — שְׁרֵי) beginning; the firstling
  3. שֵׁרוּ — v. שֵׁירוּ
  4. שֵׁירוּ — v. שֵׁירוּתָא II, III
  5. שְׁרֵי — to untie, unharness; to disengage, dismiss; to allow, permit; to forgive; to absolve (= h. הִתִּיר); to loosen the girdle,] to sit down for a meal; trnsf. to start, begin; to encamp, dwell, rest; Pa. same; Pa. to untie, loosen; Pa. to begin; Pa. to cause to rest, v. infra; Af. to untie, v. supra; Af. to cause to encamp
  6. שָׂרַי — b. h.) pr. n. f. Sarai, the original name of Sarah
  7. שָׂרָה — m. ch., v. שָׂרָא
  8. שָׂרָה ² — b. h.); princess, v. שַׂר; pr. n. f. Sarah, a) wife of Abraham
  9. שָׁרָה — v. שרי
  10. שרי — to dissolve, soak, steep. Naz. VI; Nif. to be soaked, dissolved
  11. שָׁרִי — v. שָׁרִיתָא

[13] שרו (Aramaic) = "they sang" — in: סמכו רבנן לרבי זירא [שרו] ליה הכי לא כחל
  rejected: שרי ²
  1. שֵׁירוּתָא ² — שְׁרֵי) beginning
  2. שֵׁירוּי — שְׁרֵי) beginning; the firstling
  3. שֵׁרוּ — v. שֵׁירוּ
  4. שֵׁירוּ — v. שֵׁירוּתָא II, III
  5. שְׁרֵי — to untie, unharness; to disengage, dismiss; to allow, permit; to forgive; to absolve (= h. הִתִּיר); to loosen the girdle,] to sit down for a meal; trnsf. to start, begin; to encamp, dwell, rest; Pa. same; Pa. to untie, loosen; Pa. to begin; Pa. to cause to rest, v. infra; Af. to untie, v. supra; Af. to cause to encamp
  6. שָׂרַי — b. h.) pr. n. f. Sarai, the original name of Sarah
  7. שָׂרָה — m. ch., v. שָׂרָא
  8. שָׂרָה ² — b. h.); princess, v. שַׂר; pr. n. f. Sarah, a) wife of Abraham
  9. שָׁרָה — v. שרי
  10. שרי — to dissolve, soak, steep. Naz. VI; Nif. to be soaked, dissolved
  11. שָׁרִי — v. שָׁרִיתָא

[14] ומשרין (Aramaic) = "and would sing" — in: אמהתא דבי קיסר לאפיה [ומשרין] ליה הכי רבא דעמיה
  rejected: שרי ²
  1. שִׁרְיָן — v. שִׁרְיָינָא
  2. שָׁרִיתָא — = שְׁרָרִי׳; שְׁרַר; cmp. כָּשׁוֹרָא) [binder,] joist, beam, post
  3. שְׁרֵי — to untie, unharness; to disengage, dismiss; to allow, permit; to forgive; to absolve (= h. הִתִּיר); to loosen the girdle,] to sit down for a meal; trnsf. to start, begin; to encamp, dwell, rest; Pa. same; Pa. to untie, loosen; Pa. to begin; Pa. to cause to rest, v. infra; Af. to untie, v. supra; Af. to cause to encamp
  4. שָׂרַי — b. h.) pr. n. f. Sarai, the original name of Sarah
  5. שָׂרָה — m. ch., v. שָׂרָא
  6. שָׂרָה ² — b. h.); princess, v. שַׂר; pr. n. f. Sarah, a) wife of Abraham
  7. שָׁרָה — v. שרי
  8. שרי — to dissolve, soak, steep. Naz. VI; Nif. to be soaked, dissolved
  9. שָׁרִי — v. שָׁרִיתָא

[15] אותן (Hebrew) = "them" — in: עידי נפשות היו מכניסין [אותן] ומאיימין עליהן שמא תאמרו
  rejected: אוֹת III
  1. Klein: אַתָּן — tonic
  2. Klein: אתן — to gain strength; — Hith. he gained strength, recovered
  3. Klein: אַתֶּן — you, ye
  4. Klein: אֵת ᴵ — the mark of the accusative. Usually prefixed only to a definite noun, as in אֶת־הָאִישׁ (= the man)
  5. Klein: אֵת ᴵᴵ — with
  6. Klein: אֵת ᴵᴵᴵ — a cutting instrument usually rendered by ‘plowshare’
  7. Klein: אַתְּ — you, thou
  8. אַתָּה — v. אָנֹכִי) thou
  9. אֵתָן — v. אֵיתָן
  10. אֵיתָן — essence, permanent or normal condition; adj. essential, strong; pr. n. river Ethan
  11. אִתְ־ — formative prefix of the Ithpa., Ithpe. and Ithpo., and corresponding nouns; in Talmud mostly אִיתְ־; cmp. אִסְ

[16] אכתפיה (Aramaic) = "on his shoulder" — in: רב אחא מרכיב לה [אכתפיה] ומרקד אמרי ליה רבנן
  rejected: כְּתַף
  1. כָּתַף — cmp. כָּתַת) to join; denom. כָּתֵף; Pi. denom. of כָּתֵף) to carry; to shoulder
  2. כַּתָּף — preced.) carrier, porter
  3. כַּתַּף — Pl. כַּתָּפִין, כַּתָּפַיָּא
  4. כָּתֵף — v. כָּתַף); joint, shoulder. Shebi. III; grapes on an arm of a vine which branches off into twigs, contrad. to נטף grapes hanging down from the trunk. 
  5. כְּתַף ² — (no English given)

[17] דלאו (Aramaic) = "that not" — in: תרי קטלא קטלי חדא [דלאו] מלכא אנא וקא קרית
  rejected: לַאו
  1. לֵאוּ — v. ליאוּ
  2. לֵיאוּ — לְאִי, לְעִי); labor; earning, acquired property
  3. או־ — prefix, esp. for verbal nouns, e.g; או, אוו = εὐ-αὐ, v. אב
  4. אַב־ — a prefix of words of Greek origin answering to αὐ-, au-, e.g. אבטומטוס = αὐτόματος; or to εὐ, e.g. אבגינוס = ε
  5. אָב I — Assyr. A-bu, Schr. K. A. T., p
  6. אָב II — const. אֲבִי, אַב [embracer], father, ancestor, progenitor; teacher; chief, leader; author, originator; fathers, ancestors, patriarchs &c; Aboth, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions (v. תְּפִלָּה), so called because it alludes to the Pat; Aboth, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, containing sayings of Talmu
  7. אָב II ² — ch., v. אַבָּא
  8. אֵב — swelling, spreading, whence; the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk; pl. אִבִּין, אִיבִּין state of growth, development
  9. אוֹ I — v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) or; או … או either … or
  10. אוֹ — (no English given)
  11. דִּילְמָא — = דִּי לְמָא, v. Ezra VII; lest, perhaps; without the meaning of apprehension) perhaps, it may be

[18] לית (Aramaic) = "there is not" — in: מילי חסירות אבל יתירות [לית] לן בה חסירות מאי
  rejected: לַיִת
  1. יַת — v. אִית) [being, existence,] a particle; indicating the objective case (= h. אֵת); with pronominal suffix of the third person) he himself, this one &c

[19] בפני (Aramaic) = "at the face of" — in: רבי יונתן מותר להסתכל [בפני] כלה כל שבעה כדי
  rejected: פָּנִים
  1. פני — b. h.); to turn (one’s face). Yoma; to turn around, go away; act. verb) to turn, pervert; to turn aside, go out, (euphem.) to ease one’s self; to vacate (v. infra); to free, release; Pi. to empty, remove, transfer; Pi. to free, acquit; Nif. to turn; Nif. to be removed, to die; Nif. to be free, at leisure; Nif. to ease 
  2. פְּנֵי I — to turn to or from; to go; to remove, empty, v. infra., v. infra; to ease one’s self; Pa. to clear, empty, remove; Pa. to free, acquit; Pa. to ease one’s self; Af. to turn, direct; to take aside; Af. to vacate, free (one’s mind); to take time; Af. to ease one’s self; Ithpe. to turn; to go away
  3. פּנַי — v. פְּנִים
  4. פְּנִים — v. I Kings VI
  5. פְּנֵי II — c. = h. פָּנוּי; free (from service); empty; turning around, restless

[20] צור (Hebrew) = "rock" — in: עד כי ביה יי [צור] עולמים אמר ליה כל
  rejected: צוּר I
  1. Klein: צור ᴵ — to bind, wrap, tie; to confine in, narrow, compress; to enclose, shut in; to lay siege to, besiege; — Qal he bound (money in bags); — Qal he confined in; — Qal he enclosed, shut in; — Qal he laid siege to, besieged; — Niph. was besieged (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring
  2. Klein: צור ᴵᴵ — prob. base of צַוָּאר (= neck)
  3. Klein: צור ᴵᴵᴵ — to fashion, shape, form; — Qal he shaped, fashioned, formed
  4. Klein: צור ᴵⱽ — to show hostility to, treat as a foe; — Qal he showed hostility to, treated as a foe
  5. צוּר II — to turn; to tie around, wrap; to form, shape; with על) to surround, besiege. Sifré; cmp. זוּר) to press, v. צִיר I; Pi. to draw, paint; to embroider
  6. צוּר — to tie around; to draw, shape, design; with על) to besiege; Pa. to form, shape, paint, engrave; Pa. to tie up, fold under; Ithpa. to be embroidered, shaped
  7. צוּר III — preced. wds.) [twist,] צ׳ דקל band made of palm-bark (cmp. נֵצֶר III).—Pl. constr. צוּרֵי
  8. צוּר ² — Pl. צוּרֵי
  9. צוֹר — b. h.) pr. n. pl. Tyre in Phœnicia
  10. צַוַּר — v. צַיַּאר
  11. צַיַּאר — mostly in pl. constr. צַוְּורֵי, צַוְּרֵי

[21] בת (Aramaic) = "daughter of" — in: מרתא [בת] בייתוס עתירתא דירושלים הויא
  rejected: בַּת I
  1. בַּת II — adv. בְּבַת [daughter, product of], בב׳ ראש (= בב׳ זקירת ראש) headlong; בב׳ אחת (= בב׳ עשייה אחת, בב׳ כתיבה &c
  2. בַּת III — c. (b. h.) bath, a measure; v. בֵּיתָא II
  3. בֵּיתָא I — same; night-lodging
  4. בֵּיתָא II — = h. בַּת) bath, a measure
  5. בַּיְתָא — night-bird, v. בָּאוָת

[22] דבידים (Aramaic) = "which is by direct action" — in: דממילא אבל מכה בהמה [דבידים] אימא לא
  rejected: יַד
  1. דָּם — constr. דַּם (b. h.; דום or דמם, cmp. דבב) liquid; blood; life
  2. דָּם ² — blood; life; congestion
  3. יָד — f. (rarely m.) (b. h; hand; forefoot; handle; power, authority, possession, share; portion, part.—Pl. יָדוֹת

[23] ובידים (Aramaic) = "and by direct action" — in: והמת יהיה לו דשכיחא [ובידים] אימא לא
  rejected: יַד
  1. דָּם — constr. דַּם (b. h.; דום or דמם, cmp. דבב) liquid; blood; life
